description: Lock project toolchains and explain their execution paths
pre_install: if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64' -or $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 -eq 'ARM64') { throw 'Pinset publishes native Windows x64 only; Windows ARM64 is not supported.' }
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Pinset could not refresh managed tool entries. Run this installation with self repair after resolving the reported error.' }
notes: The CLI and pinset-shim.exe are installed together. Tool entries live in PINSET_HOME\v3\bin.
Run pinset self shell powershell to print the explicit shell setup; no profile is edited.
Use scoop update pinset for upgrades; do not use pinset self update for this Scoop installation.
Uninstalling deletes Scoop's package files. PINSET_HOME keeps copied CLI/router, tool entries, SDKs and state, so pinset may remain on PATH.
